blind.description: A stylized wooden barrel bound by dark metal hoops, filled to the brim with various edged weapons including swords, daggers, and a small axe. The weapons feature steel blades pointing down into the barrel with reddish-brown wrapped hilts, brass/gold crossguards, and rounded silver and gold pommels protruding upward. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with no floating, melted, or disconnected geometry. Underside sits flat on the ground.
blind.from_above: A circular ring of wooden barrel staves containing a radially arranged cluster of weapon hilts, blades, and pommels pointing outward and inward, casting a finger-like spiky shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches approximately waist-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and is roughly 1.5 to 2 ft wide.
